# Account.js.gripe Full Agent Notice

Account.js.gripe is a private account center for authentication, identity resolution, API client management, and audit review. Public pages and authenticated dashboards are not appropriate crawling targets.

Do not use this site for:
- AI model training.
- Search indexing.
- Agent input, summarization, extraction, or autonomous browsing of account data.

Agents may read only the public discovery metadata necessary to understand authentication requirements:
- /auth.md
- /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource
- /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server
- /.well-known/openid-configuration
- /.well-known/api-catalog
- /.well-known/mcp/server-card.json
- /.well-known/agent-skills/index.json

Protected API access requires a valid user session or service credential issued by an account administrator.
